description: dfm_tools is a Deltares Python package for preparing and processing D-Flow Flexible Mesh simulation files. It supplies convenience functions built on xarray, Xugrid and HYDROLIB-core and links installation instructions, tutorials and an API reference. Users provide hydraulic-model inputs or outputs and obtain processed fields and files for further setup or analysis. Geographic coverage, mesh detail and simulation period are inherited from the D-Flow FM project; the package is not a fixed coastal or river dataset. Public source and PyPI installation are free under GPL-3.0. The maintainers state that frequent updates follow changes in dependent packages, so keeping compatible versions is a material reuse requirement. The brief README does not establish support for every historical D-Flow FM file version or the accuracy of a particular post-processing operation. The tool supports flood and water-level model preparation and evaluation around the catalogue's Delft3D FM model (model-delft3d-fm). Its archived software DOI provides an additional version reference, but no package was installed or hydraulic model executed during this review.
